scripts.convex: npm run --workspace=@moagent/api codegen --silent && concurrently -k "npm run --workspace=@moagent/api dev" "npm run worker"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run --workspace=@moagent/web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=@moagent/web typecheck && npm run --workspace=@moagent/api typecheck && npm run --workspace=@moagent/worker typecheck
